facts.raw_span: Gradual hair loss of the eyelashes, eyebrows, beard, and scalp for 4 years
Swelling and painful hand joints for 13 months
Multiple asymptomatic nodules on the upper arms for 40 days
No fever
No previous infections, family history, or personal medical history of autoimmune diseases or psoriasis
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate: 27 mm/h (slightly elevated)
Rheumatoid factor: 70.1 IU/mL (significantly elevated)
Normal results for: C-reactive protein, anticyclic citrullinated peptide, antinuclear antibodies, and globulin levels
X-ray and joint ultrasound showed: osteoarthritis, synovitis, flexor tendon tenosynovitis, and bone erosions
Diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis (hematoxylin-eosin stain)
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present (acid-fast stain)
Fundus fluorescein angiography showed uveitis

concepts.why: The presence of non-caseating granulomas, as suggested by the diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes, and the presence of numerous acid-fast bacilli, along with the uveitis, are highly suggestive of sarcoidosis.

support_spans: Swelling and painful hand joints for 13 months
Rheumatoid factor: 70.1 IU/mL (significantly elevated)
contradict_spans: No decreased sensation to pain, temperature and/or touch
concepts.why: The significantly elevated rheumatoid factor and the presence of synovitis, flexor tendon tenosynovitis, and bone erosions are highly suggestive of rheumatoid arthritis.

support_spans: Gradual hair loss of the eyelashes, eyebrows, beard, and scalp for 4 years
Multiple asymptomatic nodules on the upper arms for 40 days
Diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis (hematoxylin-eosin stain)
concepts.why: The presence of skin nodules and the diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes, along with the hair loss, are suggestive of lupus pernio, a form of cutaneous sarcoidosis.
